ana: Quick rollup — runtime perf sprint status. Posting checklist, owners, and blockers. Please reply with emoji or short note.

ana: Milestones: kernel microkernel PRs aimed to merge today (PR #3421), continuous-batching canary scheduled Thu, KV prefetch p95 target <=45ms.

vikram: Can someone grab owner for the canary window? I can take rollback/fallback logic.

selena: I’ll own canary config + rollout policy. Pinged infra for quota bump.

jordan: KV prefetch load test failing at 95th percentile, dropping traces here: 
```
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] node-3 kv_prefetch: p95=142ms, p99=480ms, evictions=120/s
[2026-03-18 09:12:04] node-3 cache: hot_slate_hits=18%, miss_penalty=30ms
```

maria: Triaging now — looks like eviction thrash on node-3. Increasing hot-slate allocation might reduce churn. Will try a config patch (RT-5123).

opsbot: Deploy pipeline queued: canary-config-update -> infra-approve (triggered by selena).

selena: @maria if you can push the config patch I’ll coordinate the canary window and keep rollback hooks ready.

vikram: Also need a quick CR review on the microkernel optim (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3421) — just 2 small nits blocking merge.

jordan: ack, will review in ~30m.

ana: Decisions for this thread: 1) bump hot-slate from 128MB -> 256MB? 2) enable async prefetch backoff globally or only in canary? Vote with :+1: / :-1:.

maria: +1 for 256MB, +1 for backoff but prefer backoff gated behind canary flag first.

selena: +1 / +1 (canary-first).

vikram: +1 for 256MB, 0 for global backoff (prefer canary-only).

ana: Ok good consensus. @maria please open the config PR and tag @selena. If canary passes we promote to staging then prod. I’ll update the sprint board with new dates.

runtime-bot: Ticket RT-5123 updated: 'kv-prefetch: increase hot-slate and add prefetch-backoff' assigned to maria, selena.

ana: Thanks everyone — if you hit blockers DM me. Short async check: any other cross-team deps to surface? cc @eng-sre

eng-sre: We’re tracking infra quota approval; infra said they’ll approve once canary window is set. We’ll monitor node-3 during the first hour of canary.

ana: Perfect. Quick follow-ups: maria will open PR, selena will schedule canary slot, vikram watches rollback logic, jordan reviews CR. Closing this thread unless something new comes up. :thumbsup:
